title: Canonical efficiency drift report (per concept)
description: Output of verify_canonical_params.py for one model_setup.py file. Produced by Claude (Sonnet by default) and parsed back for the drift comparator. Schema-first design: each field has a deterministic structural shape so cross-run diffs are interpretable despite LLM phrasing variance.

energy_capture.description: Energy Capture value from table.csv for this concept.

canonical_eta_th.description: Expected eta_th from lib/canonical_params._CANONICAL_EFFICIENCIES, or null when the energy_capture key is unrecognized.

canonical_eta_de.description: Expected eta_de from lib/canonical_params._CANONICAL_EFFICIENCIES, or null when the energy_capture key is unrecognized.

observed_eta_th.description: Each canonical (non-sweep) eta_th kwarg/constant assignment Claude found in the file. Null if no canonical eta_th line exists (e.g., custom-physics concepts without costingfe.forward()).

value.description: Numeric value found on that line.

context.description: What the surrounding comments describe the value as.

observed_eta_de.description: Each canonical (non-sweep) eta_de / eta_dec kwarg/constant assignment Claude found. Null if no eta_de line exists.

deviations.description: Each '# DEVIATION:' annotation Claude found on an eta_th / eta_de line.

has_source_citation.description: True if the DEVIATION comment includes a Source: or §reference pointer.

rationale_summary.description: Optional one-line paraphrase of the deviation rationale.

narrative_contradictions.description: Cases where a kwarg value contradicts its own surrounding sourcing/narrative (e.g. eta_th=0.55 next to a 'MARS Rankine ~36%' comment block).

missing_kwargs.description: Kwargs implied by Energy Capture but absent from the file. For Hybrid concepts both eta_th and eta_de should be set; for Direct concepts eta_de must be set (eta_th may legitimately be absent if costingfe's auto-zero applies via pulsed_conversion=INDUCTIVE_DEC).

scenario_sweep_findings.description: Findings for eta_th / eta_de values sitting inside scenario sweep blocks (dict literals, lists, loops keyed by Conservative/Optimistic/Pessimistic/etc.). Sweep values are EXPECTED to differ from canonical and MUST NOT be flagged as drift. Flag only contradictions WITHIN the sweep — e.g. 'Optimistic' value equal to the 'Conservative' value (likely the standardizer flattened it).

concern.description: Why this sweep value is suspect (e.g., 'standardized from 0.45 to 0.35, but scenario name is Optimistic — likely flattened by standardizer').

confidence_notes.description: Anything else Claude wants to surface — ambiguity, uncertainty about Energy Capture mapping, unusual structure, etc.

prompt_version.description: Version string of the prompt template used. Increment when the prompt is changed in a way that affects output structure.
